turns.question: How many MQLs did paid social bring in during September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no MQL metric; the closest is Leads (CRM leads created, counted on the day each was created), and social-channel campaigns brought in 40 leads in September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
